quote: Endomorphisms of symbolic algebraic varieties (Gromov 1999, Journal of the European Mathematical Society, 1(2): 109–197)
note: The sofic group conjecture was introduced by Mikhail Gromov in his 1999 paper 'Endomorphisms of symbolic algebraic varieties' published in the Journal of the European Mathematical Society. Benjamin Weiss introduced the term 'sofic' (from Hebrew סופי meaning 'finite') in 2000, formalizing the conjecture.
